about.title: About Me
about.p1: Hey! I'm Ayat, a developer at INVOLYS in Casablanca. Day to day, I work on enterprise web apps for institutions like CNSS, AMDIE, ONHYM, and AMMC — mostly with .NET on the backend and React on the frontend.
about.p2: Outside of work, I'm building Nino — a multi-tenant SaaS that connects animal shelters with people looking to adopt. It's taught me more about system design, auth, and payments than any course ever could.
about.p3: I'm looking to relocate to Germany and join a team where I can grow. I've got B1 German (OSD cert) and working on B2. If you're hiring, let's talk.

projects.title: Projects

items.name: Nino — Pet Adoption SaaS
items.description: Problem: Animal shelters struggle to manage adopters, vet bookings, and donations across disconnected tools. Solution: Built a multi-tenant SaaS with role-based dashboards, a filtered pet browser, vet booking, donation system, and real-time analytics using ASP.NET 8, React, SQL Server, Stripe, and Vite. Result: Shelters can manage adoptions end-to-end in one platform, with automated booking and donation tracking.

items.name: Enterprise Applications @ INVOLYS
items.description: Problem: Moroccan institutions (CNSS, AMDIE, ONHYM, AMMC) needed scalable enterprise software for complex data management and reporting. Solution: Delivered full-stack enterprise web apps with .NET backend, React frontend, and SQL Server/Oracle databases. Result: Institutions now run reporting and data operations on a unified, maintainable platform.

items.name: Animal Planet Adoption Platform
items.description: Problem: Pet adopters had no central place to browse, search, and adopt animals across multiple categories. Solution: Built a full-featured pet adoption website with listings management, intuitive browsing, an e-commerce shop section, and multi-category animal support using React, Laravel, MySQL, and PHP. Result: Users can browse and adopt pets across dogs, cats, birds, and rodents through a single shop-integrated platform.

items.name: Electric Vehicle Rental
items.description: Problem: Renting electric cars and bikes lacked a unified booking and vehicle management platform. Solution: Developed a responsive web platform with a booking system and vehicle management using Vite, Laravel, and MySQL. Result: Customers can browse and reserve electric vehicles online with a mobile-friendly experience.
